Flooding is possible 2 hours either side of high tide on Tuesday morning. 
Areas particularly at risk include low quaysides, harbours and low-lying roads/ car parks at Port Quinn, Port Gaverne, Port Isaac and Bude. 

The high tide at Padstow on Tuesday 27th October is at 05:29, times of high water will vary along the coast.  Forecast total high tide level is 4.09mAOD. Expect tide levels along the coast to be between 0.15 and 0.20 metres above tide table level.  Storm force 6 Westerly winds and offshore wave heights of over 4.40m are forecast over the high tide.
